Benchmark.title: Example Operating System Security Technical Implementation Guide
Benchmark.description: Synthetic STIG used only for automated tests and demos of stigref.
Benchmark.notice: Test fixture. Not for production hardening.

Rule.title: The Example OS must enforce multi-factor authentication for network access.
Rule.description: <VulnDiscussion>Without multi-factor authentication, unauthorized access is more likely.</VulnDiscussion><FalsePositives></FalsePositives><FalseNegatives></FalseNegatives><Documentable>false</Documentable><Mitigations></Mitigations><SeverityOverrideGuidance></SeverityOverrideGuidance><PotentialImpacts></PotentialImpacts><ThirdPartyTools></ThirdPartyTools><MitigationControl></MitigationControl><Responsibility></Responsibility><IAControls></IAControls>
Rule.fixtext: Configure the Example OS to require multi-factor authentication for network access per vendor documentation.

check.check-content:
Verify multi-factor authentication is enabled for network logons.
If multi-factor authentication is not enabled, this is a finding.

Rule.title: The Example OS must lock accounts after three failed logon attempts.
Rule.fixtext: Set the lockout threshold to three failed attempts.

check.check-content:
Check the account lockout threshold.
If the threshold is not three, this is a finding.
